name: locusai-local-bash
description: Allowlisted bash execution against the LocusAI project directory, running as a persistent Docker service reached over TCP (localhost:1443). Connects via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's transports in-process and reconnects automatically when the server container is rebuilt.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run one allowlisted binary with an argv list inside the mounted project directory. No shell is invoked.
